title_en: Classic Illustrated Water Margin 18: The Uprising at Huashan

full_text_zh:
[P1] 闹华山
水浒
之十八
出版说明
《水浒》是我国的一部著名的古典文学著作。为了满足广大读者的需要，我们把它编绘成连环画册。在编绘上尽量保持原著故事情节，但是为了适合用连环画来表现，个别情节也作了一些删节和改动。
全部画册分为三十集，每集有比较完整的故事，可以独自成章；同时各集内容上下衔接，以便连续阅读。为了阅读方便，每集开头写有内容提要，结尾附有后记，用以交代上集、本集和下集故事大意。
《水浒》连环画，我社1956年——1962年陆续出版过。现在这套连环画，是用原有的文学脚本重新绘制的。

闹 华 山
(《水浒》之十八)
徐淦 改编
刘汉宗 绘
四谛书院 扫描
侠骨丹心 制作

人民美术出版社

[P3] 内容提要
上集《三山聚义》说的是慕容知府派呼延灼去
打桃花山。桃花山李忠向二龙山求救，鲁智深等带领
人马支援。白虎山孔明、孔亮到青州劫牢救叔父，三
山人马聚义打破青州后，并入梁山。
本集《闹华山》是写三山聚义后，鲁智深到少华
山看望史进，得知史进被华州贺太守押在牢中，便前
去营救，也被贺太守捉住。梁山发兵来救。吴用探知
皇帝派宿太尉到华山降香，用计赚了金铃吊挂，扮装
宿太尉混进华州城。贺太守中计，梁山众英雄救出鲁
智深和史进。

我愿和
师兄同去。

久闻九
纹龙大名，
你去请他来
最好，更劳
武松兄弟相
伴。

1 话说三山聚义破青州后不久，这天，花和尚鲁智深
要往少华山探望结义兄弟九纹龙史进，并邀请他来入伙。
宋江应允。

[P4] 2 鲁智深、武松走后，宋江放心不下，又叫神行太保戴宗随后跟去，探听消息。
3 少华山在华州华阴县地界。华州府太守姓贺，原是蔡京的学生，是个残害百姓的贪官。

[P5] 4 有一天，贺太守到华山金天圣帝庙烧香，看见画影壁画的老汉身旁有个女子，年轻貌美，他就起了邪念；派人去打听，知道老汉叫王义，那女子是他女儿玉娇枝。

5 贺太守派衙役三番两次威胁王义，要强娶玉娇枝作妾，都被王义父女拒绝了。

好个美貌女子，何不娶她作三房。

我不愿意，你敢怎样？

太守看中你的姑娘，你敢不依！

[P6] 6 太守派兵丁逮捕了王义，抢走了玉娇枝。
7 玉娇枝被抢到太守府后，趁派来解劝她的女眷没有防备，投井死了。

[P7] 8 王义还不知女儿已死，哀求释放；贺太守怕他上告，便诬赖他通匪，发配到很远的地方充军。
9 两个解差押着王义，一路打骂虐待，经过少华山下时，偏巧碰见山寨大头领九纹龙史进。
这人犯的
什么罪？你们
这等凶狠！

[P8] 10 王义要哭诉经过，解差不许，又用木棍抽打，吆喝他快走。史进见了大怒，上前拦住。
11 史进听完王义哭诉，越发恼怒，杀了凶恶的解差。

[P9] 12 王义被史进救上山寨，见过神机军师朱武、跳涧虎陈达和白花蛇杨春。
13 三位兄长，小弟生来嫉恶如仇，今去刺死狗官为民除害。
13 史进愤怒难消，嘱咐朱武等安置王义，自己要到华州府刺死狗官。

[P10] 14 史进走后不久，少华山探兵回报朱武说：史进行刺未成，被人发觉，拿住关进监牢；贺太守还准备派兵进攻山寨。
15 正在这时，鲁智深和武松从梁山访问史进来了。朱武和陈达、杨春三人下山迎接。
正是洒家，这是打虎的武松。为何不见史进兄弟？
师父就是延安府鲁提辖吧？

[P11] 这狗官敢如此无礼，洒家便去结果了那厮。
天色已晚，先请二位到寨里商议。
16 鲁智深不见史进，追问朱武。朱武只得把史进被捉，关在牢里的经过，详细告诉了一遍。鲁智深听了，立刻就要前去搭救史进。
哥哥不要性急。
若等敌兵到来，史兄弟早没命了。
17 朱武摆酒款待鲁智深和武松，并叫王义出来相见。武松主张先回梁山请宋江发兵攻打华州府；鲁智深等不及，一定要独自马上前往。

[P12] 18 众人劝了半天，各自休息。四更天，鲁智深悄悄起身，独自下山。
19 鲁智深直奔华州城里，向行人打听太守衙门。行人告诉他过桥往东便是。

[P13] 20 刚走到渭河桥上，忽听行人说：‘太守过来了，和尚快躲开。’鲁智深心想正要寻他，他倒撞在俺眼前了。
21 只见华州府的仪仗队鸣锣喝道，一对对慢慢过来了。

[P14] 22 贺太守坐着暖轿，垂下轿帘；两旁有十几个虞侯各拿枪鞭铁链，戒备森严。
23 鲁智深想下手，又恐怕打不着反被人耻笑。他迟疑了一下，却被贺太守从轿窗里看见了。

[P15] 好好！
太守请师傅到府用斋。
24 贺太守回到府内，立刻叫两个虞侯到桥上去请鲁智深。鲁智深心想：这狗官找死，就跟随来人前去。
你是出家人，
好不晓事！这是太
守府堂，怎能准你
带刀棒杖！
25 鲁智深进了太守府，来到厅前。太守吩咐下来，要
他放下刀杖，进去用斋。鲁智深起先不肯。

[P16] 26 虞侯一定要他放下刀杖。鲁智深想：只靠两个拳头，也能打碎他那脑袋；便放下刀杖进去。
27 贺太守坐在后堂，把手一招，两旁立刻走出几十个兵丁，冷不防就把鲁智深捆住。
你这秃驴，想必是来行刺，给我快快招来。
洒家不曾来你，为何拿我？

[P17] 俺是梁山泊好汉
鲁智深。你这狗官，
快些放出史进和玉娇
枝，免得梁山大兵一
到，后悔不及！
28 贺太守高声喊打，鲁智深破口大骂。
29 贺太守大怒，叫人取一面大枷给鲁智深戴上，押往
死牢。禅杖、戒刀都被拿去封锁入库。

[P18] 我两个来华州干事，折了一个，回去怎么交代！
30 这事哄动了华州府。武松、朱武等听见探报，大吃一惊。
31 恰好戴宗奉宋江之命赶到，商议结果，仍由戴宗赶回梁山求救。

[P19] 32 神行太保戴宗不到三天就跑回梁山，向晁盖、宋江报告。
33 宋江当天点起七千人马，前军、中军、后军一共十三个将领，分作三队出发。

[P20] 34 这日，三队人马来到少华山下。戴宗先去送信，武松引朱武、陈达、杨春下山迎接。
35 宋江、吴用和众头领商议如何攻取华州，搭救鲁智深和史进。
华州不易
攻打，除非里
应外合。
先到城边
探望一番，再
作道理。

[P21] 36 当夜，宋江、吴用、花荣、秦明、朱仝五个头领来到华州城外，只见城墙高而坚固，护城河又深又阔，背后是西岳华山，确是一座难攻的城池。
37 五人回到少华山，宋江愁眉不展，想不出攻城计策。吴用说先派人探听一下消息再商议。

[P22] 哥哥别急，
计在这里了。
38 隔了两天，军士探报，皇帝派太尉宿元景带着金铃
吊挂来西岳进香，已经乘船由黄河入渭河。
39 吴用见是机会，用计安排：先向李俊、张顺交代，
由杨春引路下山。

[P23] 40 次日，吴用请宋江、李应、朱全、呼延灼、花荣、秦明、徐宁等带五百余人，悄悄来到渭河渡口。
41 李俊、张顺、杨春已雇好十几只大船等候。吴用叫花荣、秦明、徐宁、呼延灼引军埋伏岸上。

[P24] 42 宋江、吴用、朱仝、李应上了大船。李俊、张顺、杨春分别乘船藏在滩后。
43 等候了一夜，天色刚亮，远远望见三只官船来到，船头插着黄旗，上写“钦奉圣旨西岳降香太尉宿”。

[P25] 你等什么船只，
胆敢当港拦截大臣？
44 等太尉船近了，朱仝、李应拿枪站在宋江、吴用背后，当港拦住。官船上走出二十几个虞侯喝问为何拦船。
太尉奉旨降香，你们既是义士，为何拦截？
梁山泊义士
宋江等参拜。
45 宋江上前参见宿太尉，吴用在船头高声赞礼。官船上的客帐司听见忙出来答话。

[P26] 休得胡说。太尉命臣，怎能跟你等相见？
46 宋江回答说要面见太尉，有事相商。客帐司喝问什么人敢要强见太尉。
47 宋江说：“太尉不肯相见，只怕孩儿们惊了太尉。”说完手一挥，朱仝立刻把枪上的小号旗摇晃起来。

[P27] 48 花荣等四人引出军马，一齐弯弓搭箭，威风凛凛地摆列在岸上。官船上的艄公都吓得钻进舱里去了。
49 客帐司慌得进去报告，宿太尉无法，只得到船头坐下。宋江请他上岸，宿太尉哪里肯去。
朝廷大臣怎能随便上岸。
我们没有别意，只请太尉上岸一谈。

[P28] 50 吴用说：“太尉若不肯时，只怕下面伙伴们也不答应。”果然李应把号带枪一招，李俊、张顺、杨春一齐撑出小船来。宿太尉大惊。
51 李俊、张顺举刀跳上官船，先把两个虞侯推下河去。
休得胡来！
惊了贵人。

[P29] 52 他俩听了宋江的话，才扑通跳下水去，又把两个虞侯送上船来。
53 两人在水面如走平地，跟着又跳上官船，吓得宿太尉直打哆嗦。
这里不便说话，只请上山一谈，决不相害。
义士们……
要……怎样？

[P30] 54 宿太尉只得离开官船，由宋江派花荣、秦明陪他骑马先上少华山。
55 随后宋江等上马，吩咐众人把船上所有的人连同御香祭物和金铃吊挂，一齐带上山去，只留李俊、张顺带领一百余人守船。

[P31] 只是不要
连累下官。
只借你衣物搭
救两个兄弟，用毕
归还，决不相害。
56 宿太尉被带上山寨。宋江向他说明两个兄弟无辜被
贺太守陷害，要借金铃吊挂和官家衣饰去赚华州。宿太尉
见这些人忽硬忽软，只怕自家性命难保，哪敢不依。
57 宋江挑选一个面孔胖胖的军士剃去胡须，穿上太尉
衣服，扮做宿太尉。宋江、吴用也改扮做客帐司。

[P32] 58 解珍、解宝、杨雄、石秀扮作虞侯。花荣、徐宁、朱仝、李应扮做卫兵。其他军士也都紫衫银带，举着旌节、旗幡、仪仗、法物，抬着御香、祭礼、金铃吊挂。
59 另叫秦明、呼延灼、林冲、杨志各引一队人马分作两路准备攻城；武松先去西岳庙门下等候，只听号起行事；戴宗扮作军士先到云台观报信。

[P33] 60 安排已毕，假太尉等一路下山，乘坐原官船径往西岳庙开去。
61 西岳云台观观主得报，带领道徒到河边迎接。太尉上岸。

[P34] 62 假太尉只说途中生病，让轿夫把暖轿抬到庙里才歇下，由客帐司扶进官厅。
63 客帐司吴用问观主，为何不见本州官员前来迎接。
太尉奉旨降香，华州官员为何如此轻慢？
已派人往报，大概就到。

[P35] 64 正说着，贺太守派来的一个推官（府内副职官员）带领衙役送来酒果。推官看见旌旗仪仗都是东京内府之物，并不疑心。
65 那太尉托病围着被褥坐在床上。客帐司吴用出入两次，假作禀报，引推官进去，远远地在阶下参拜。

[P36] 太守因梁山泊
贼人攻城，不敢离
开。先派我来献酒，
随后就到。
太尉是天子前
近幸大臣，因公染
病未痊，州官如何
不来远接。
66 太尉只用手指，客帐司传下话来，指责州官。
67 客帐司说太尉病得很厉害，叫太守快来商议行礼。
推官和衙役敬过酒，客帐司又进去禀明太尉，取来钥匙。

[P37] 68 客帐司当众开锁从柜内取出金铃吊挂，用竹竿叉起，果然是巧匠制造，七宝珍珠嵌成，珊瑚、玛瑙、翠玉无数，浑金架子中间吊着盏红纱灯笼，真是民间罕有的奇物。
69 推官满口称赞。客帐司又交下许多公文，叫转告太守快来商议行礼。

[P38] 70 这时武松已在庙门下。吴用又叫石秀前来帮助行事。另换戴宗改扮虞侯。
71 宋江正在观看庙殿建筑，门上道士报告，贺太守来了。宋江叫花荣、徐宁、朱仝、李应四个“衙兵”各拿兵器分列两旁；解珍、解宝、杨雄、戴宗各藏暗器站在左右。

[P39] 只请太守入见，别人止步。
72 贺太守带着将领兵丁三百余人，来到庙前下马，众人卫护贺太守进庙。客帐司在内高喊禁止闲杂人等近前。
73 众兵将只得远远站住。贺太守独自一人上前拜见太尉。

[P40] 太守
你知罪吗？

下官不知
太尉驾到，伏
乞恕罪。

74 贺太守望着太尉下拜。客帐司宋江代太尉发话。

太尉奉旨
降香，如何不
来远接？

不曾接到
近报，有失远
迎。

75 客帐司吴用接着又严厉地责问贺太守。

[P41] 76 吴用喝声拿下，解珍、解宝弟兄两个就嗖地拔出短刀。
77 解珍一脚踢翻贺太守；解宝一刀把他的头砍了下来。

[P42] 78 宋江高声喊道：“弟兄们动手。”花荣等就从两边杀来。
79 华州兵将吓慌了，一半被砍倒，一半向庙外冲跑，碰着武松、石秀带着军士四下赶杀，不留一个。

[P43] 80 随后到庙里来的华州府官员也都被张顺、李俊杀了。
81 宋江急叫收了御香吊挂，改换原来打扮。云台观主和道徒们早已吓得藏躲起来。

[P44] 82 众头领乘船赶往华州，远远望见城内两处火起。原来秦明、林冲两路人马已乘虚攻下华州，正在扫灭残余官兵。宋江等下船入城，一路杀到监牢。
83 武松、朱武先到牢中救出史进、鲁智深。

[P45] 久闻哥哥大名，感谢搭救。
这是宋哥哥，这是吴军师。
84 鲁智深引了史进去见宋江和吴用。
85 众人进入州衙，宋江叫打开华州库藏，取出金银布匹，装载上车。

[P46] 86 王义也跟来了，听说女儿玉娇枝投井死了，在井边痛哭。
87 宋江等安慰了王义一回，送他一些财物，叫他回乡谋生。王义谢了又谢。

[P47] 88 宋江又叫取出大部分金银财物，救济受过官府残害的百姓；并且四处传告梁山已除了姓贺的这个祸害。
89 诸事处理完毕，宋江等才离开华州；华州百姓依依惜别，扶老携幼送出城外很远。

[P48] 90 宋江回少华山见了宿太尉，交还金铃吊挂和借用的衣物，又取出一盘金银相赠；随从人等也都给了些金银。然后宋江派军士送宿太尉一行下山登上原来的官船。
91 史进等四位少华山头领决定同去梁山入伙。他们收拾了财物，烧了寨栅，带领全寨弟兄，欢欢喜喜跟着宋江的大队人马，向梁山进发。

[P49] 后记
下集《大名府》说的是：段景住往梁山献马，路上被曾头市夺去。晁盖怒打曾头市，中箭身亡。宋江做寨主，决定招卢俊义入伙。吴用计赚卢俊义上山。卢俊义不肯落草，回家遭恶奴陷害入狱，燕青救主失主。梁山泊三打大名府，救出卢俊义，卢俊义终于上山。

闹华山

full_text_en:
[P1] Raid on Huashan
Water Margin
No. 18
Publishing Note
"Water Margin" is a famous classical Chinese literary work. To meet the needs of a wide readership, we have adapted it into a series of illustrated storybooks. In the adaptation, we have tried to preserve the original plot as much as possible, but have made some deletions and modifications to suit the format of illustrated stories.
The entire series consists of thirty volumes, each containing a relatively complete story that can stand alone; at the same time, the content of each volume connects with the others for continuous reading. For convenience, each volume begins with a content summary and ends with a postscript, which outlines the plot of the previous, current, and next volumes.
The "Water Margin" illustrated series was previously published by our publishing house from 1956 to 1962. This current set of illustrated stories has been newly drawn using the original literary scripts.

[P2] Table of Contents
Volume 1: Nine-Striped Dragon Shi Jin
Volume 2: Lu Zhishen
Volume 3: The Wild Boar Forest
Volume 4: Lin Chong's Snowy Night Ascent to Liangshan
Volume 5: Yang Zhi Sells His Sword
Volume 6: The Clever Seizure of the Birthday Tribute
Volume 7: Shijie Village
Volume 8: Song Jiang Kills Xi
Volume 9: The Lion's Den
Volume 10: The Joyful Forest
Volume 11: Qingfeng Fort
Volume 12: The Riot at Jiangzhou
Volume 13: Li Kui Descends the Mountain
Volume 14: Three Attacks on Zhu Family Manor
Volume 15: Gaotang Prefecture
Volume 16: The Great Breakthrough of the Chain Horse Formation
Volume 17: The Gathering of Three Mountains
Volume 18: The Riot at Huashan
Volume 19: Daming Prefecture
Volume 20: Zengtou City
Volume 21: Heroes Rank Their Seats
Volume 22: Li Kui Causes Trouble in Dongjing
Volume 23: Yan Qing Fights the Tournament
Volume 24: Black Whirlwind Tears the Imperial Edict
Volume 25: Two Breaks of Tong Guan
Volume 26: Three Defeats of Gao Qiu
Volume 27: Accepting the Imperial Recruitment and Being Betrayed
Volume 28: Breaking the Liao Kingdom, All in Vain
Volume 29: Campaigning Against Fang La, Suffering Heavy Losses
Volume 30: Liao'er Bay

Riot at Huashan
(The Water Margin, Volume 18)
Adapted by Xu Gan
Illustrated by Liu Hanzhong
Scanned by Sidi Academy
Produced by Xianggu Danxin

People's Fine Arts Publishing House

[P3] Content Summary
The previous episode, "The Gathering of the Three Mountains," tells of how Governor Mucon sent Hu Yanzhuo to attack Peach Blossom Mountain. Li Zhong of Peach Blossom Mountain sought help from Erlong Mountain, and Lu Zhishen led troops to support him. Kong Ming and Kong Liang from White Tiger Mountain raided Qingzhou to rescue their uncle, and after the three mountain forces united and broke Qingzhou, they joined Liangshan.
This episode, "The Uprising at Huashan," follows the gathering of the three mountains. Lu Zhishen visits Shaohua Mountain to see Shi Jin, learns that Shi Jin has been imprisoned by Governor He of Huazhou, and goes to rescue him, but is also captured by Governor He. Liangshan sends troops to rescue them. Wu Yong learns that the Emperor has sent Minister Su to Huashan for a religious ceremony, devises a plan to obtain the Golden Bell Pendant, disguises himself as Minister Su, and infiltrates Huazhou City. Governor He falls for the trick, and the heroes of Liangshan rescue Lu Zhishen and Shi Jin.

I wish to go with
my elder brother.

I've long heard of
Nine-Scale Dragon's fame.
You should go invite him.
It would be best, and please
ask Brother Wu Song to accompany you.

1. Not long after the three mountains united and broke Qingzhou, on this day, the Flower Monk Lu Zhishen was to travel to Shaohua Mountain to visit his sworn brother, Nine-Scale Dragon Shi Jin, and invite him to join the cause. Song Jiang agreed.

[P4] 2 After Lu Zhishen and Wu Song left, Song Jiang was still worried, so he called upon Divine Traveler Dai Zong to follow them and gather information.
3 Shaohua Mountain is located within the territory of Huazhou, Huayin County. The governor of Huazhou, surnamed He, was once a student of Cai Jing and a corrupt official who oppressed the people.

[P5] 4 One day, Governor He went to the Jin Tian Sheng Di Temple on Huashan Mountain to burn incense. He saw a painting on the wall depicting an old man with a young, beautiful woman beside him. He became lustful and sent people to inquire. He learned the old man was named Wang Yi, and the woman was his daughter, Yu Jiao Zhi.

5 Governor He sent衙役 (yé yì, officials) to threaten Wang Yi repeatedly, demanding to forcibly marry Yu Jiao Zhi as his concubine. But both Wang Yi and his daughter refused.

Good-looking woman! Why not marry her as my third wife?

I don't want to! What will you do?

The governor has set his eyes on your daughter. How dare you refuse!

[P6] 6 The governor sent soldiers to arrest Wang Yi and seize Yu Jiaozhi.
7 After Yu Jiaozhi was taken to the governor's mansion, she took advantage of the lack of guard from the women sent to persuade her, and jumped into a well to die.

[P7] 8 Wang Yi still did not know his daughter had died, and begged for release; He Taishou, fearing he would report him, falsely accused him of being a bandit and sent him to serve in the army in a distant place.
9 Two bailiffs were escorting Wang Yi, beating and abusing him along the way. When they passed beneath Shaohua Mountain, they coincidentally encountered the mountain chief, Nine-Tattooed Dragon Shi Jin.
What crime has this man committed? You are so cruel!

[P8] 10 Wang Yi tried to cry out his story, but the guards wouldn't allow it, beating him with sticks and shouting for him to move on. Shi Jin saw this and became furious, stepping forward to block them.
11 After hearing Wang Yi's cry, Shi Jin became even more enraged and killed the cruel guards.

[P9] 12 Wang Yi was rescued by Shi Jin and brought to the mountain stronghold, where he met the military strategist Zhu Wu, the leaping tiger Chen Da, and the white snake Yang Chun.
13 "Brothers, I have always hated evil; today I will kill the dog official to rid the people of harm."
13 Shi Jin, filled with rage, instructed Zhu Wu and others to take care of Wang Yi, and declared he would go to Huazhou Prefecture to kill the dog official.

[P10] 14 Shortly after Shi Jin left, a scout from Shaohua Mountain reported to Zhu Wu: 'Shi Jin's assassination attempt failed; he was discovered, captured, and imprisoned. Governor He is also preparing to send troops to attack the mountain stronghold.'
15 At this moment, Lu Zhishen and Wu Song arrived from Liangshan to visit Shi Jin. Zhu Wu, Chen Da, and Yang Chun went down the mountain to greet them.
'I am the one, this is Wu Song who killed the tiger. Why is Brother Shi Jin not here?'
'You must be Master Lu Tixia from Yancheng Prefecture, right?'

[P11] This dog official dares to be so impolite; I'll go and finish him off.
It's getting late; let's first invite the two of you to the camp to discuss.
16 Lu Zhishen couldn't find Shi Jin and questioned Zhu Wu. Zhu Wu had no choice but to tell Lu Zhishen in detail about how Shi Jin was captured and imprisoned. After hearing this, Lu Zhishen immediately wanted to go rescue Shi Jin.
Brother, don't be so hasty.
If we wait for the enemy troops to arrive, Brother Shi will be dead by then.
17 Zhu Wu served wine to Lu Zhishen and Wu Song, and called Wang Yi out to meet them. Wu Song suggested returning to Liangshan to ask Song Jiang to send troops to attack Huazhou Prefecture; Lu Zhishen, however, couldn't wait and insisted on going alone right away.

[P12] 18 After everyone had劝 for a long time, they each rested. At the fourth watch, Lu Zhishen quietly got up and went down the mountain alone.
19 Lu Zhishen rushed into Huazhou city, asking passersby for the way to the governor's office. The passerby told him to cross the bridge and go east.

[P13] 20 Just as he reached the Wei River Bridge, he suddenly heard a passerby say, 'The governor is coming, monk, hurry and get out of the way.' Lu Zhishen thought, 'I was just looking for him, and he has stumbled right into my sight.'
21 He saw the governor's procession of attendants beating gongs and shouting, coming slowly in pairs.

[P14] 22 Governor He sat in a warm palanquin with the curtain drawn down; on both sides, over a dozen attendants held spears, whips, and iron chains, guarding with strict vigilance.
23 Lu Zhishen wanted to strike, but feared that if he missed, he would be ridiculed. He hesitated for a moment, but was spotted by Governor He from the palanquin window.

[P15] Hooray!
The governor invites the master to the府 for a meal.
24 The Governor He returned to his mansion and immediately sent two attendants to the bridge to invite Lu Zhishen. Lu Zhishen thought: This dog official is asking for death, so he followed the people to go.
You are a monk,
How ignorant! This is the governor's hall, how can you be allowed to carry a knife and staff!
25 Lu Zhishen entered the governor's mansion and arrived at the hall. The governor ordered him to put down his weapon and enter to have a meal. Lu Zhishen at first refused.

[P16] 26 The attendant insisted that he put down his weapon. Lu Zhishen thought: With just two fists, I could crush his skull; so he put down his weapon and went in.
27 Governor He sat in the rear hall, waved his hand, and immediately dozens of soldiers came out from both sides, catching Lu Zhishen by surprise.
You bald ape, you must be here to assassinate me. Confess quickly!
I never came to you, why are you arresting me?

[P17] I am Lu Zhishen, a hero from Liangshan.
You dog of an official,
quickly release Shi Jin and Yu Jiaozhi,
or you'll regret it when the Liangshan army arrives!
28 Governor He shouted angrily, and Lu Zhishen cursed back.
29 Governor He became furious, ordered a large wooden collar to be placed on Lu Zhishen, and had him taken to the death cell. His staff and dagger were taken away and locked in storage.

[P18] We came to Huazhou to do business, but lost one of us. How can we explain this back home?
30 This incident caused a stir in the Huazhou prefecture. Wu Song, Zhu Wu, and others, upon hearing the report, were greatly shocked.
31 Just then, Dai Zong arrived, sent by Song Jiang. After discussing, they decided that Dai Zong would return to Liangshan to seek help.

[P19] 32 The Divine Traveler Dai Zong returned to Liangshan in less than three days and reported to Chao Gai and Song Jiang.
33 That day, Song Jiang mustered seven thousand troops, with thirteen generals in the vanguard, center, and rearguard, divided into three columns and set out.

[P20] 34 On this day, three detachments arrived at the foot of Shaohua Mountain. Dai Zong went first to deliver the message, while Wu Song led Zhu Wu, Chen Da, and Yang Chun down the mountain to greet them.
35 Song Jiang, Wu Yong, and the other leaders discussed how to capture Huazhou and rescue Lu Zhishen and Shi Jin.
Huazhou is not easy
 to attack, unless we have
 inside and outside cooperation.
First, go to the city outskirts
 to scout around, then
 make a decision.

[P21] 36 That night, the five leaders — Song Jiang, Wu Yong, Hua Rong, Qin Ming, and Zhu Tong — arrived outside Huazhou city. They saw that the city walls were high and sturdy, the moat deep and wide, and behind it lay Mount Hua, the Western Peak. It was indeed a difficult fortress to attack.
37 The five returned to Shaohua Mountain. Song Jiang frowned in worry, unable to devise a plan to attack the city. Wu Yong suggested sending someone first to gather information before discussing further.

[P22] Brother, don't worry, the plan is here.
38 Two days later, soldiers reported that the Emperor had sent Grand Marshal Su Yuanjing, carrying the golden bell and hanging ornaments, to pay homage at the Western Peak, and he had already sailed from the Yellow River into the Wei River.
39 Wu Yong saw this as an opportunity and made arrangements: first, he instructed Li Jun and Zhang Shun, and then had Yang Chun lead the way down the mountain.

[P23] 40 The next day, Wu Yong invited Song Jiang, Li Ying, Zhu Quan, Hu Yanzhuo, Hua Rong, Qin Ming, Xu Ning, and others, leading over five hundred men, to secretly arrive at the Wei River ferry.
41 Li Jun, Zhang Shun, and Yang Chun had already hired several large boats to wait. Wu Yong ordered Hua Rong, Qin Ming, Xu Ning, and Hu Yanzhuo to lead troops to lie in ambush on the shore.

[P24] 42 Song Jiang, Wu Yong, Zhu Tong, and Li Ying boarded the large ship. Li Jun, Zhang Shun, and Yang Chun each took separate boats and hid behind the shore.
43 After waiting through the night, just as dawn broke, they saw three official ships approaching from afar, with yellow flags at the bow, inscribed with the words 'By Imperial Command, the Grand Marshal of the Western Peak, Su Yuanjing, on a pilgrimage.'

[P25] What kind of vessel are you? 
How dare you block the way of a high official?
44 As the Grand Secretary's boat approached, Zhu Tong and Li Ying stood behind Song Jiang and Wu Yong with their spears, blocking the harbor. Several dozen attendants stepped out of the official boat and shouted, asking why they were blocking the ship.
Grand Secretary, on a mission to offer incense as commanded by the Emperor, you are righteous men, why do you intercept us?
Righteous men of Liangshan Marsh,
Song Jiang and others pay their respects.
45 Song Jiang stepped forward to greet Grand Secretary Su, while Wu Yong loudly offered his respects from the bow of the boat. The guest steward on the official boat, upon hearing this, hurried out to respond.

[P26] Stop talking nonsense. The Grand Secretary has ordered me; how could I possibly meet with you?
46 Song Jiang replied that he wished to meet the Grand Secretary to discuss some matters. The Guest Accountant shouted, asking who dared to force a meeting with the Grand Secretary.
47 Song Jiang said, "The Grand Secretary refuses to meet, for fear that our men might startle him." He then waved his hand, and Zhu Tong immediately waved the small flag on his spear.

[P27] 48 Hua Rong and three others led out their troops, all drawing their bows and arrows, standing in a mighty formation on the shore. The boatmen on the official ship were so frightened they crawled into the cabin.
49 The guest attendant hurried to report to the Minister Su. Minister Su had no choice but to sit at the bow of the ship. Song Jiang asked him to come ashore, but Minister Su refused.
How can a court minister casually go ashore?
We have no ill intentions, we only ask the Minister to come ashore for a talk.

[P28] 50 Wu Yong said, "If the Grand Secretary refuses, I fear our comrades below will not agree." Indeed, Li Ying waved his signal spear, and Li Jun, Zhang Shun, and Yang Chun all rowed out in small boats. Grand Secretary Su was greatly alarmed.
51 Li Jun and Zhang Shun leapt onto the official boat with drawn blades, first pushing two attendants into the river.
Stop this nonsense!
You're alarming the noble person.

[P29] 52 They jumped into the water after hearing Song Jiang's words, then brought the two yu hou back onto the boat.
53 The two walked on the water as if on flat ground, then jumped back onto the official boat, scaring Minister Su to tremble.
It's inconvenient to talk here. Please come up the mountain to discuss. We will not harm you.
Heroes... 
What... do you want?

[P30] 54 The Minister Su had no choice but to leave the official boat, escorted by Hua Rong and Qin Ming, sent by Song Jiang, to ride horseback to Shaohua Mountain first.
55 Then Song Jiang and others mounted their horses, ordering everyone to take all the people on the boat, along with the imperial incense offerings and golden bells, up the mountain, leaving only Li Jun and Zhang Shun to lead over a hundred men to guard the boat.

[P31] Just don't
involve me.
I only borrow your clothes to
save my two brothers, will return them after use, and will never harm you.
56 Minister Su was brought to the mountain stronghold. Song Jiang explained to him that his two brothers had been wrongfully framed by Governor He, and requested to borrow the golden bell pendant and official attire to deceive Huazhou. Minister Su, seeing these people alternate between firmness and leniency, feared for his own life and dared not refuse.
57 Song Jiang selected a plump-looking soldier, shaved off his beard, dressed him in the Minister's clothes, and made him impersonate Minister Su. Song Jiang and Wu Yong also disguised themselves as the guest account officer.

[P32] 58 Xie Zhen, Xie Bao, Yang Xiong, and Shi Xiu disguised themselves as attendants. Hua Rong, Xu Ning, Zhu Tong, and Li Ying disguised themselves as guards. Other soldiers wore purple robes with silver sashes, carrying banners, flags, ceremonial objects, and ritual items, and carrying imperial incense, offerings, and golden bells.
59 Also, Qin Ming, Hu Yanzhuo, Lin Chong, and Yang Zhi each led a detachment of troops, divided into two routes to prepare for the attack on the city; Wu Song went first to wait under the gate of the West Mountain Temple, ready to act upon the signal; Dai Zong disguised himself as a soldier and went first to YunTai Temple to deliver the message.

[P33] 60 After everything was arranged, the fake Grand Secretary and his entourage descended the mountain and sailed the original official boat directly to the West Peak Temple.
61 Upon receiving the report, the abbot of the West Peak YunTai Temple led his disciples to the riverside to welcome the Grand Secretary. The Grand Secretary disembarked.

[P34] 62 The fake Grand Secretary claimed to be ill on the journey, so the bearers carried the warm palanquin into the temple before stopping, and he was then helped into the official hall by the guest attendant.
63 The guest attendant Wu Yong asked the abbot, 'Why haven't the local officials come to greet us?'
'The Grand Secretary has come on imperial orders to offer incense. Why are the officials of Huazhou so disrespectful?'
'We've already sent someone to notify them. They should arrive soon.'

[P35] 64 Just as they were speaking, a push official (a deputy official in the prefecture) sent by Governor He, accompanied by衙役, arrived with wine and fruit. The official saw that the banners and ceremonial equipment were all from the Inner Court of Dongjing and did not suspect anything.
65 The pretended Grand Commander was pretending to be ill, sitting on the bed wrapped in blankets. The guest chamberlain Wu Yong entered and exited twice, pretending to report, leading the official inside, and bowed from afar at the steps.

[P36] The governor, because Liangshan outlaws are attacking the city, dares not leave. I was sent first to offer wine, and he will arrive shortly.
The Grand Secretary is a close minister to the Emperor, and is ill from official duties. How can the local officials not come to greet him?
66 The Grand Secretary merely points with his finger, and the Guest Accountant relays the message, scolding the local officials.
67 The Guest Accountant says the Grand Secretary is very ill, and urges the governor to come quickly to discuss the ceremony. After the judge and衙役 offer wine, the Guest Accountant goes in again to report to the Grand Secretary and retrieves the key.

[P37] 68 The guest account officer unlocked the cabinet in front of everyone, took out the golden bell hanging ornament, and lifted it with a bamboo pole. It was indeed crafted by a master artisan, inlaid with seven-precious pearls, coral, agate, and emerald jade in countless amounts. In the center of the solid gold frame hung a red silk lantern—truly a rare treasure of the common world.
69 The push official praised it highly. The guest account officer then handed over many official documents, instructing them to inform the governor to come quickly to discuss the ceremony.

[P38] 70 At this time, Wu Song was already at the temple gate. Wu Yong called Shi Xiu to come and assist. He also had Dai Zong change into the role of a yu hou (attendant).
71 Song Jiang was observing the temple buildings when a Taoist at the gate reported that Governor He had arrived. Song Jiang ordered Hua Rong, Xu Ning, Zhu Tong, and Li Ying — four 'guards' — to take their weapons and stand on both sides; Jie Zhen, Jie Bao, Yang Xiong, and Dai Zong were to hide their weapons and stand on either side.

[P39] Only the governor is allowed to enter; others, stop here.
72 Governor He, accompanied by over three hundred officers and soldiers, dismounted before the temple. The guards escorted Governor He into the temple. The guest attendant shouted from inside, forbidding any idle or unauthorized persons to approach.
73 The soldiers and officers could only stand far away. Governor He approached alone to pay respects to the Grand Secretary.

[P40] Governor
Do you know your crime?

Your servant did not know
the Grand Secretary had arrived. I beg for forgiveness.

74 Governor He bowed before the Grand Secretary. The guest officer Song Jiang spoke on behalf of the Grand Secretary.

The Grand Secretary has come on imperial orders
for incense offerings. Why did you not
come to greet him?

We did not receive
a recent report. We failed in our distant
welcome.

75 The guest officer Wu Yong then sternly questioned Governor He.

[P41] 76 Wu Yong shouted, 'Seize him!' and immediately, Xie Zhen and Xie Bao, the two brothers, drew their short blades.
77 Xie Zhen kicked He Taishou to the ground; Xie Bao slashed off his head with a single stroke.

[P42] 78 Song Jiang shouted loudly, "Brothers, attack!" Hua Rong and others charged from both sides.
79 The soldiers and officers of Huazhou were frightened, half were cut down, half rushed out of the temple, only to be chased and killed by Wu Song, Shi Xiu, and their troops from all sides, not leaving a single one.

[P43] 80 The Huazhou officials who later arrived at the temple were also killed by Zhang Shun and Li Jun.
81 Song Jiang hurriedly ordered the imperial incense and hanging ornaments to be taken down and his original attire to be changed. The master of Yuntai Temple and his disciples had already hidden in fear.

[P44] 82 The leaders sailed towards Huazhou and saw two fires rising from within the city. It turned out that Qin Ming and Lin Chong's forces had already seized Huazhou by surprise and were now eliminating the remaining soldiers. Song Jiang and others disembarked and entered the city, fighting their way to the prison.
83 Wu Song and Zhu Wu arrived at the prison first and rescued Shi Jin and Lu Zhishen.

[P45] Long have I heard of your great name, thank you for rescuing me.
This is Brother Song, this is General Wu.
84 Lu Zhishen led Shi Jin to meet Song Jiang and Wu Yong.
85 The group entered the prefectural office. Song Jiang ordered the treasury of Huazhou to be opened, and gold, silver, and cloth were taken out and loaded onto carts.

[P46] 86 Wang Yi arrived as well, and upon hearing that his daughter Yu Jiaozhi had jumped into a well and died, he wept bitterly by the well.
87 Song Jiang and others comforted Wang Yi for a while, gave him some valuables, and told him to return to his hometown to make a living. Wang Yi thanked them again and again.

[P47] 88 Song Jiang then ordered most of the silver and treasures to be taken out to relieve the common people who had suffered from the government's oppression; and also spread the news that Liangshan had eliminated the disaster caused by the man surnamed He.
89 After all matters were settled, Song Jiang and others finally left Huazhou; the people of Huazhou bid them farewell with deep affection, carrying the old and leading the young to send them far beyond the city gates.

[P48] 90 Song Jiang returned to Shaohua Mountain and met with Minister Su. He returned the golden bell pendant and borrowed clothes, and also presented a tray of gold and silver as a gift; he gave some gold and silver to Su's attendants as well. Then Song Jiang sent soldiers to escort Minister Su and his entourage down the mountain and onto their original official boat.
91 Shi Jin and the other three leaders of Shaohua Mountain decided to join Liangshan. They gathered their belongings, burned their camp, led all their brothers, and happily followed Song Jiang's large army toward Liangshan.

[P49] Postscript
The next volume, 'Daming Prefecture,' tells of: Duan Jingzhu went to Liangshan to present a horse, but it was stolen by Zengtou City on the way. Chao Gai angrily attacked Zengtou City and was killed by an arrow. Song Jiang became the leader and decided to recruit Lu Junyi. Wu Yong devised a plan to lure Lu Junyi to the mountain. Lu Junyi refused to join the outlaws, returned home, was framed by a wicked servant and imprisoned, and Yan Qing failed to rescue his master. Liangshan attacked Daming Prefecture three times, rescued Lu Junyi, and Lu Junyi finally joined the mountain.

Trouble at Huashan
Original authors: Shi Nai'an, Luo Guanzhong

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为《水浒》连环画第十八集《闹华山》的封面及出版说明，介绍了该系列连环画的改编原则、结构安排和出版背景。
[P2] 本页为《水浒》连环画第十八集《闹华山》的目录页和封面信息，列出了全系列三十集的标题，并注明了本集的改编者、绘者、扫描和制作单位，以及出版社。
[P3] 本页为《水浒》连环画第十八集《闹华山》的内容提要和第一幅画面。提要回顾了上集《三山聚义》的情节，并介绍了本集鲁智深前往少华山探望史进、营救被囚的史进，最终梁山英雄成功救出两人的故事主线。第一幅画面描绘了宋江与鲁智深、武松商议前往少华山的情景。
[P4] 本页描绘了鲁智深和武松离开后，宋江派戴宗暗中跟随探听消息，以及介绍了少华山所在地和华州府太守贺太守的背景，揭示其为蔡京门生且贪赃枉法。
[P5] 本页讲述了华州府太守贺太守在华山金天圣帝庙看到画中女子玉娇枝后心生邪念，派人打听得知其父为王义，随后多次派衙役威胁王义，欲强娶玉娇枝为妾，但遭到父女二人坚决拒绝。
[P6] 本页描绘了华州府太守贺太守派兵逮捕王义并抢走玉娇枝，以及玉娇枝被掳至太守府后，趁女眷不备投井自尽的情节。
[P7] 本页描绘了王义被诬陷通匪发配充军，以及他被解差押解途中经过少华山，恰逢山寨大头领史进出现的情节。史进质问解差为何如此对待王义。
[P8] 王义被解差押解途中遭殴打，史进见状上前阻止，听其哭诉后怒杀解差。
[P9] 王义被史进救上少华山，见到了朱武、陈达和杨春三位头领。史进听闻王义遭遇后怒不可遏，决定独自前往华州府刺杀贺太守为民除害。
[P10] 本页讲述了史进刺杀贺太守失败被捕，贺太守准备进攻山寨；随后鲁智深和武松从梁山前来探望史进，朱武等人下山迎接，双方见面并互相问候。
[P11] 鲁智深得知史进被捕后怒不可遏，欲独自前去营救；朱武劝其先商议，武松主张回梁山请宋江发兵，鲁智深则坚持立即行动。
[P12] 鲁智深在众人劝阻后仍于四更天独自下山，直奔华州城，向行人打听太守衙门的位置。
[P13] 鲁智深在渭河桥上得知太守即将到来，正欲寻仇，却见华州府仪仗队缓缓而来。
[P14] 本页描绘了贺太守乘坐戒备森严的暖轿出行，鲁智深在桥边欲行刺却因迟疑被贺太守发现的情景。
[P15] 贺太守派人请鲁智深到府中用斋，鲁智深随行前往；进入府邸后，太守吩咐他放下兵器，鲁智深起初不肯。
[P16] 鲁智深进入贺太守府邸，放下兵器后被贺太守识破意图，随即被兵丁擒获。贺太守质问其行刺动机，鲁智深反问为何被抓。
[P17] 鲁智深在贺太守府中破口大骂，要求释放史进和玉娇枝，被贺太守下令戴上大枷并押往死牢，禅杖和戒刀也被收缴入库。
[P18] 鲁智深刺杀贺太守失败被捕后，武松、朱武等人得知消息大惊；戴宗奉宋江之命赶到，商议后决定由戴宗返回梁山求援。
[P19] 戴宗返回梁山向晁盖、宋江报告鲁智深被捕的消息，宋江随即点齐七千人马，分三队出发救援。
[P20] 梁山三队人马抵达少华山下，戴宗先行送信，武松等人下山迎接。随后，宋江、吴用与众头领商议攻取华州、搭救鲁智深和史进的策略，认为需里应外合，先探明城中情况再作决断。
[P21] 宋江等五位头领夜探华州城，发现城防坚固，难以强攻；返回少华山后，宋江忧心忡忡，吴用提议先派人探听城中消息再作商议。
[P22] 军士探报皇帝派太尉宿元景带金铃吊挂赴西岳进香，吴用见机行事，安排李俊、张顺由杨春引路下山执行计划。
[P23] 吴用带领宋江等人悄悄来到渭河渡口，李俊、张顺、杨春已备好船只，吴用安排花荣、秦明、徐宁、呼延灼率军在岸边埋伏。
[P24] 宋江、吴用等人登上大船，李俊、张顺、杨春则藏于滩后。次日清晨，他们望见三艘插有黄旗的官船驶来，旗上写着‘钦奉圣旨西岳降香太尉宿’。
[P25] 梁山好汉在渭河渡口拦截太尉宿元景的官船，朱仝、李应持枪挡道，官船上的虞侯质问其缘由；随后宋江上前参见宿太尉，吴用高声赞礼，官船上的客帐司出面回应。
[P26] 梁山好汉在渭河渡口拦截太尉宿元景的官船，宋江请求面见太尉，客帐司拒绝并质问其身份，宋江以‘怕惊扰太尉’为由，示意朱仝摇动小号旗，准备采取进一步行动。
[P27] 梁山好汉在渭河渡口摆开阵势，花荣等人弯弓搭箭，震慑官船；客帐司向宿太尉报告，宿太尉被迫坐于船头，宋江请其上岸，但宿太尉拒绝，双方对峙。
[P28] 吴用以同伴们会不满为由施压，李应发信号后，李俊、张顺、杨春驾小船靠近官船，宿太尉大惊；随后李俊、张顺跳上官船，将两名虞侯推入河中，官船上有人惊呼‘休得胡来！惊了贵人’。
[P29] 李俊、张顺跳入水中后又跃上官船，将两名虞侯推入河中，宿太尉惊恐不已。宋江派人劝说宿太尉上山商谈，宿太尉惊惧询问梁山好汉的意图。
[P30] 宿太尉在梁山好汉的陪同下离开官船，骑马前往少华山；宋江等人随后上马，命令将官船上所有人员及御香祭物等一并带上山，仅留李俊、张顺率百余人守船。
[P31] 宿太尉被梁山好汉带上山寨，宋江向其说明借官服和金铃吊挂是为了救被贺太守陷害的兄弟，并以此骗取华州；宿太尉因惧怕性命不保而答应。随后，宋江挑选一名军士剃须换装，扮作宿太尉，自己与吴用则改扮为客帐司。
[P32] 本页描述了梁山好汉为攻城所做的伪装和部署：部分人扮作虞侯和卫兵，携带仪仗和祭品；同时安排秦明、呼延灼、林冲、杨志分两路攻城，武松在西岳庙待命，戴宗前往云台观报信。
[P33] 假太尉等人乘官船前往西岳庙，西岳云台观观主率道徒在河边迎接，假太尉上岸。
[P34] 假太尉一行抵达西岳庙，因称病未下轿，由客帐司吴用扶进官厅；吴用质问观主为何不见华州官员迎接，观主称已派人通报，官员应很快到达。
[P35] 贺太守派来的推官送来酒果，未起疑心；假太尉托病卧床，吴用假作禀报引推官入内，自己在阶下参拜。
[P36] 假太尉在西岳庙称病，通过客帐司吴用传话指责州官未及时迎接；随后吴用谎称太尉病重，催促太守前来商议，并在推官和衙役敬酒后，进入内室禀报并取走钥匙。
[P37] 客帐司吴用在西岳庙当众取出金铃吊挂，展示其华美以取信推官；随后交下公文，催促华州太守尽快前来商议行礼事宜。
[P38] 本页描述了梁山好汉在西岳庙的部署：武松已在庙门下待命，吴用调来石秀并让戴宗改扮为虞侯；宋江得知贺太守到来后，安排花荣等四人持兵器分列两旁，解珍等四人藏暗器待命，准备迎接并应对太守。
[P39] 贺太守率兵丁三百余人抵达西岳庙前，被要求只准其一人入内拜见太尉，其余人等不得靠近，众兵将只得在远处等候。
[P40] 贺太守在西岳庙内向假太尉下拜，客帐司宋江代太尉质问其罪过；随后吴用严厉追问贺太守为何未远迎，贺太守以未接到近报为由辩解。
[P41] 吴用下令拿下贺太守，解珍、解宝随即拔刀将其踢翻并砍下头颅。
[P42] 宋江下令动手，花荣等人从两侧杀出；华州兵将惊慌溃逃，被武松、石秀等人追杀殆尽。
[P43] 梁山好汉杀死随后进入庙中的华州府官员，宋江随即下令收起伪装用的御香吊挂并换回原装，云台观主和道徒们因惊吓而躲藏起来。
[P44] 梁山好汉乘船抵达华州，发现城内已起火，秦明、林冲已攻占华州并清扫残敌。宋江等人进城后直奔监牢，武松与朱武率先救出被囚禁的史进和鲁智深。
[P45] 鲁智深带史进拜见宋江和吴用，随后众人进入州衙，宋江下令打开华州府库，取出金银布匹并装车。
[P46] 王义得知女儿玉娇枝投井身亡后，在井边痛哭。宋江等人安慰他并赠送财物，让他回乡谋生，王义再三感谢。
[P47] 宋江命人取出大部分金银财物救济受官府残害的百姓，并宣告已除掉贺太守这一祸害；随后梁山好汉们处理完所有事务，离开华州，百姓们依依不舍地扶老携幼送行至城外很远。
[P48] 宋江返回少华山向宿太尉交还物品并赠送财物，随后送其下山登船；史进等四位少华山头领决定加入梁山，收拾财物、烧毁寨栅，带领部众随宋江大军向梁山进发。
